prompt: Explain this to me like I'm new to it

muc.title: Only seeing the chat box
muc.text: Many people open Claude, type a few questions and stop there. But behind that chat box is a whole toolbox.

muc.title: One account, three places
muc.text: One account works in your browser, on the phone app and on the desktop app. Start on your phone, keep going on your computer.

muc.title: The free plan already has 4 tools
muc.text: Even the free plan gives you four tools: chat for questions, sending photos and files for Claude to read, web search for fresh information, and voice mode for talking out loud.

muc.title: Eight drawers above
muc.text: Above that are eight more drawers: turn answers into Artifacts, design slides and web pages with words, gather work into Projects, teach Claude a process with Skills, hand long tasks to Cowork, use it right inside Chrome and Excel, build tools with Claude Code even if you can't code, and a lab for scientists.

muc.title: One tool per part
muc.text: Each part of this series takes out one tool, explains what it's for, whether the free plan has it, and how to try it right away.

muc.title: Snap a confusing piece of paper
muc.text: Take a photo of a confusing piece of paper, like a bill, a prescription or a contract, send it to Claude and ask: explain this to me like I'm new to it. Remember to double-check the important parts.

muc.title: Turn answers into something you can use
muc.text: You have answers. Part 2: turn them into Artifacts, meaning documents, slides or tools you can take away and use.
